module_summary: UART transmitter: one-hot 4-phase FSM (idle/start/data/stop) with a baud divider timer and bit counter shifting an 8-bit shift register onto tx_o.

anchors.name: ph
anchors.why: One-hot phase register: idle, start bit, data bits, stop bit; drives tx_o and ready.

anchors.name: sr
anchors.why: Shift register loaded with tx_data, shifted right per bit; LSB drives tx_o.

anchors.name: tmr
anchors.why: Baud divider counting to CLK_DIV-1 while not idle; produces wrap bit tick.

anchors.name: nb
anchors.why: Bit counter incremented per shifted bit; all-ones ends data phase.

anchors.name: tx_valid
anchors.why: Byte request; starts frame when FSM idle.

anchors.name: tx_ready
anchors.why: Ready when FSM is idle, accepting a new byte.

anchors.name: tx_data
anchors.why: Byte payload loaded into the shift register.

anchors.name: tx_o
anchors.why: Serial line output: low start bit, sr LSB data, high stop/idle.

anchors.name: busy_o
anchors.why: Level busy indication whenever FSM is not idle.

anchors.name: wrap
anchors.why: Baud tick when timer reaches CLK_DIV-1; advances phases and shifts.

anchors.name: grab
anchors.why: Load enable: idle and valid loads sr and clears bit counter.

anchors.name: roll
anchors.why: Shift enable: data phase baud tick shifts sr and bumps nb.

groups.name: tx_controller
groups.description: One-hot phase FSM sequencing start, data and stop bits; idle decode gives ready.

groups.name: baud_and_bit_counters
groups.description: Baud divider timer producing bit ticks and 3-bit data bit counter.

groups.name: tx_shifter
groups.description: Shift register serializing the byte LSB first onto tx_o.

groups.name: byte_input
groups.description: Valid/ready byte input accepted while idle.
